blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte supposedly failed to declare over P207 million worth of cash in different bank accounts belonging to her and her husband, Manases Carpio, a financial forensic analyst, Atty. Alexander Cabrera testified on Friday. At Day 37 of the impeachment trial, Cabrera — the prosecution panel’s witness for Article II of the Articles of Impeachment — was asked by public prosecutor and Akbayan party-list Rep. Chel Diokno to state how much cash assets Duterte did not declare in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) from 2022 to 2025.
